name: Wake Up Cowfish — Captain
source: KB: 2.3 On Board Binder - Cowfish / Waking Her Up (partially captured from .docx)
intro: Morning startup checklist for Cowfish. Note: this template may be incomplete — the Cowfish binder .docx was only partially captured during the KB harvest. Items marked [NEEDS VERIFICATION] should be confirmed against the physical binder.

items.label: Open middle aft hatch — turn battery switch ON
Trim engines down and check steering
Bump engines forward and reverse (test gear engagement)

help.title: VHF channel reference
help.body: Channel 16 is the international distress, safety, and calling frequency. Monitor throughout the day. Switch to working channels for non-emergency communication.

items.label: Check fuel gauge — fill at Conch Harbor if under 1/2 tank

help.title: Fuel threshold
help.body: Fill up at Conch Harbor if the fuel gauge reads below 1/2 tank. Coordinate with crew if a fuel stop is needed so they can adjust the boarding timeline.

items.label: Shut off engines (after systems test, before boarding)

completion.notes_prompt: Any issues found during startup? Anything to flag for the deckhand or next captain?
